g.text: How a behavioral predicate is concretized: classify at compile time, decide at run time
The substrate NEVER evaluates the algebra on a real process at compile time:
a modal formula is classified semi-decidable (is_satisfiable_3v = DontKnow)
and tagged RejectSafeApprox. The flip gate admits the rule fail-closed; the
truth of the guard is deferred to one of the three runtime mechanisms below.
GAP: only NoTerm and the TestProc fixture implement HostTerm today;
no real Rholang Par is wired in yet, so modal truth of a dispatched
process is honestly DontKnow. (ii)/(iii) are how dispatched guards decide.
semi-decidable leg: DontKnow at compile time; amber gap on (i)
classical / decidable: closed-world facts, holds(relation, tuple)
host / formal: compile-time classify-only lane and (iii) COMM at run time
the runtime decision lane (admitted guard is decided here)
How the truth is concretely computed
build_lts (cap 10000) -> denote: EXACT over the reachable LTS (HostTerm)
FactBase.holds(relation, tuple): halts/safe supplied at run time
RhoNativeJoin / where-boolean / RSpace match: f1r3node decides at COMM
